title: 'Take back' on a waiting pause or renew request is small faint grey text that does not look like a button
what: Under a request still waiting for the desk, the only way to take it back is a short line of the smallest, faintest grey text. It has no button shape, no colour and no underline, and its finger area is well under the usual size.
expected: Take back looks like a button (a ghost button like 'Pause my plan') and is at least a finger wide and tall.
how_often: every time a request is waiting
fix_line: Show Take back as a normal small button with the usual finger size

title: In the pause calendar a screen reader reads each day as a computer date, and the day circles are small
what: Each day in the pause calendar is announced as a raw code like '2026-12-04' instead of 'Friday 4 December', and today is marked only by a thin ring. The day circles are 40 points, under the 48 the rest of the app uses.
expected: Days are read as spoken dates with 'today' said, and each day is a full finger size.
fix_line: Read each day as a spoken date, say today, and make the circles a bit larger

title: The 'Your plan ends on Friday' card on the Workout tab opens the Gym tab, but nothing shows it can be tapped
what: The whole card is tappable and takes you to your gym page, but it looks like a plain notice: no arrow, no button and no words like 'See my plan'. Only a screen reader is told it opens something.
expected: The card shows it can be tapped, for example with an arrow on the right or a 'See my plan' line.
how_often: when the plan is near its end
fix_line: Add an arrow or a short 'See my plan' line to the card
